name: v2.5.26-dev.6
body:
## What's new in v2.5.26-dev.6

- feat(#128): warn before an update or source removal stops a rip or copy
- feat(recommend): per-artist blacklist and update-at-power-on
- fix(webui): show only active links and hide 0 GB boot devices
- feat(recommend): search Qobuz past its recent-search cap, seed by genre
- fix(recommend): tolerate transient MusicBrainz errors in enrichment
- feat(setup): add the driver step to the first-boot captive, bundle WIP
- tune(recommend): streaming takes most of the list, library ~20%
- chore(alpha): bundle working-tree WIP for the alpha5 build
- feat(kiosk): Recommended albums open AlbumPage, with Cover Flow and CD changer
- fix(lms): bump OsmiumConvert version so the #140 plugin rules actually ship
- chore(kiosk): the dev mock answers needed_albums like the real API
- fix(recommend): the empty screen counts streaming favourites too
- feat(recommend): streaming favourites and Deezer history shape the taste profile
- ui(kiosk): hour and minute of the Recommended run as labelled steppers
- fix(kiosk): put the Recommended lines of Browser.qml where they belong
- fix(recommend): leave half of the list to the streaming services
- docs(recommend): manual section, architecture and the licensing note
- fix(ota): carry hifi_system_tweaks.py in the System bundle
- build(recommend): ship the module, the model and the Last.fm key
- feat(recommend): backup, factory reset and the 0064 migration
- ui(recommend): any minute for the scheduled time
- feat(recommend): the local library counts as taste
- ui(webadmin): Recommended settings section
- ui(kiosk): Recommended tile, grid and settings
- feat(recommend): owner-scheduled job, compute-now and the API
- test(zones): account for the -e wma,alac exclusion in the legacy render
- feat(recommend): artist profiles, candidates and the run pipeline
- feat(recommend): collect the listening history and hold the settings
- feat(recommend): sentence embedder with an on-disk vector cache
- feat(recommend): core of the Recommended feature (history, clusters, ranking)
- fix(display): inject a forced panel mode for EDID-less 1024x600 panels (#137)
- fix(audio): stop WMA/ALAC albums wedging after one track (#140)
- fix(kiosk): keep the clock off during radio and clear the cursor on exit (#139)
- fix(dsd/dop): coherent BitPerfect verdict, DFF kiosk, DAC-ready caps, DoP auto buffer
- ui(kiosk): restore "Local Library" label (revert Album view rename)
